posts.text: unlocking a Mac is still surprisingly manual. you open your laptop, wait for the lock screen, type your password or use TouchID, and you're in. why can't it just recognize you? Your iPhone has done that for over 9 years. so i built Glance: > face unlock for your Mac using your webcam > on-device face recognition with ArcFace > protection against basic photo spoofing > support for multiple identities > your face is never uploaded or stored as a photo Glance is not as secure as Apple’s FaceID or T

Working on bringing FaceID to the Mac 👀. Ever since Apple introduced the notch to MacBooks, I've always wondered why they still haven't brought Face ID to macOS. It feels like one of those features that just belongs there. So I decided to see if I could build it myself. One of the first things I wanted to get right was the unlock animation. Hot take: edit profile pages are sloppy. They're often treated as an afterthought. But editing your profile is one of the few moments where users can actually express themselves, and they can play a BIG impact in how the user views the app. 🥗 For Munch, we wanted to embrace the playfulness of our other interactions and demonstrate our whimsy-ness.
